text:
maria (AE): Starting EmeraldBank POC thread. Scope: Okta SAML SSO (SP + IdP), SCIM user + nested-group sync, RBAC group->role mapping (tenant-scoped), DNS TXT domain verification preferred, and Private/VPC option due to PHI. Buyer asked for feasibility, a concise onboarding runbook, and Dedicated vs Private delta including one-off onboarding fees. Need a quick readout by EOD Thu. Looping @josh and @linh.

josh (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: will they push SCIM from Okta or use our SCIM client? Any expectation on sustained QPS for cutover? Also, do they require assertion-level telemetry forwarded to their SIEM?

linh (Solutions Eng): They plan to push from Okta. Directory ~9k users, ~600 groups. Cutover plan shows two windows: a 2-hour bulk import at ~40 req/s and a nightly incremental at ~8 req/s. They asked if we can guarantee a one-off 40 req/s window for onboarding.

tara (Security): PHI notes: customer-managed KMS required, and they want per-assertion metadata forwarded to their Splunk HEC for 1 year. HSM attestation optional but adds ~3-5 weeks. Need to confirm redaction policy for PII in logs.

maria (AE): Pricing ask: 4M tokens/mo baseline, 350k SCIM ops onboarding. Can we commit to 40 req/s for 2 hours as a POC addendum? Also need rough uplift Dedicated vs Private.

josh (SE): Default tenant SCIM limit is 10 req/s. Options to support 40 req/s:
- Approve scheduled burst (ops + 72h notice)
- Use bulk import endpoint (/scim/v2/Users/bulk) with chunking (recommended)
- Managed ingestion by onboarding team (one-off fee)

We can include a POC addendum for a scheduled 2-hour 40 req/s window, but Ops requires an automated safety cutoff and monitoring. Ballpark cost uplift for that window ~1.2x. Dedicated = baseline + ~20% for SLA. Private = setup + license; upfront higher, marginal token cost may be lower depending on infra. I'll produce a 1-page estimate.

linh (Solutions Eng): Technical runbook items I'll draft: SAML cert rotate checklist, SCIM chunking guidance (batch 250 users recommended), example group->role regex transforms, DNS TXT proof flow, and API examples. Example transform we'll show:

```
# Okta group -> Redwood role example
{"rule_type":"group_regex","pattern":"^eng-(.*)-(prod|staging)$","role_template":"eng-\1-\2"}
```

And SCIM bulk example snippet:

```
POST /scim/v2/Users/bulk
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Bulk"], "Operations": [...] }
```

maria (AE): Ops asks: can we promise the 72h notice requirement in writing? Buyer wants that in the POC doc.

josh (SE): Yes, we can commit to a scheduled 2-hour 40 req/s window with 72h ops notice, subject to the safety cutoff. We'll include the precise operational prerequisites (monitoring hook, cutoff threshold, and contact list).

tara (Security): For the compliance checklist: I'll add required KMS steps (customer key ARN, rotation frequency), SIEM HEC config, retention tiers (90 days vs 365 days with pricing delta), and redaction options for assertions. If they want full assertion storage for 1 year, need a storage ingest addendum.

maria (AE): Action items: @linh draft the runbook + mapping examples + bulk import samples by EOD tomorrow; @josh run capacity sim with 2KB/user average and confirm latency impact + send 1-page Dedicated vs Private estimate; @tara assemble minimal compliance checklist for procurement. I'll request their sample SCIM CSV and confirm cutover windows.

oncall-bot: ticket#11358 created: "EmeraldBank onboarding window" assigned to oncall-ops. Note: scheduled bursts require 72h notice.

linh (Solutions Eng): I'll include a small diagram and a sample curl for bulk import. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

josh (SE): DM me the sample CSV when you have it so I can run sim.

maria (AE): Will request now. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: deploy:private-package-4.2.0.tar.gz uploaded. Note: build supports SCIM bulk, group-regex mapping, and customer-managed KMS integration.
